risk_summary: The disclosure is substantially quantified and provides detailed segment, margin, debt, liquidity, and earnings data, but includes extensive standard forward-looking safe-harbor language. Reported earnings improvement appears partly dependent on nonrecurring acquisition gains and tax-position releases, while pandemic, demand, supply, regulatory, currency, and commodity risks remain material.
